before: Now here in Athens, and in Lacedaemon, the rules about love are perplexing, but in most cities they are simple and easy to grasp. In Elis and Boeotia, and in countries that have no gift for eloquence, the rules are very straightforward — the law is simply in favor of these connections, and no one, young or old, says a word against them. In Ionia, on the other hand, and in other places generally subject to the barbarians, the custom is held to be dishonorable.
